sources.title: Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 👍 Effective MoE Architecture: Wan2.2 introduces a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture into video diffusion models. By separating the denoising process cross timesteps with specialized powerful expert models, this enlarges the overall model capacity while maintaining the same computational cost.

sources.title: GitHub - Wan-Video/Wan2.2: Wan: Open and Advanced Large-Scale Video ...
sources.snippet: This model supports both text-to-video and image-to-video generation at 720P resolution with 24fps and can also run on consumer-grade graphics cards like 4090. It is one of the fastest 720P@24fps models currently available, capable of serving both the industrial and academic sectors simultaneously.

sources.title: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Turbo - GitHub
sources.snippet: Leveraging the Self-Forcing framework, it enables 4-step TI2V-5B model training. Our model can generate 121-frame videos at 24 FPS with a resolution of 1280×704 in just 4 steps, eliminating the need for the CFG trick.
